# Binary generic carrier and array transfers

This independently authored provider retains two distinct method formals in
ordered invariant input/result carrier slots. Its ordinary and variable arity
entries receive an explicit array of either formal. The provider chooses an
opaque result independently of the input carrier and array contents.

The observer checks null/empty/covariant arrays, exact original references,
carrier aliases, returned replacements, element/field snapshots, callbacks,
array-store failures, ignored calls and exact exceptions. Source and dependency
profiles compile all emitted Java8 units and preserve original definitions,
generic metadata, roles and Exceptions. Wrong programs run before recovery,
including explicit packing, copying and returned-input shortcuts. Signature-only
controls preserve Code/descriptors while breaking complete ordered bindings.
